SENSEX RECLAIMS 83,000 AS BANKS, AUTOS LEAD RALLY

On 19 November 2026 the Sensex reclaimed the 83,000 mark, while the Nifty rose above 25,500 and the Bank Nifty closed past 63,000. Auto and bank stocks led the rally.

Foreign Institutional Investors bought more than ₹1 lakh crore of Indian equities, topping buying flows and underpinning the market surge.

For information only. Not investment advice.
